xmldoc.short_description: Parse a prefilter field into structured cut-offs.

param_input_item.param_description: a signal's prefilter field, for example 'HP:0.1Hz LP:75Hz N:50Hz'.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with highpass, lowpass and notch in hertz (NaN when absent) and raw, the text as written.

description.p: The field has no rigid grammar; the common form naming a high-pass, a low-pass and a notch is understood. Every signal returned by edf.read already carries these as its highpass, lowpass and notch fields; this function is for a field in hand.
